findings.evidenceJa: この上なく機嫌が良かった
findings.governingReading: Rin is in an unsurpassably good mood despite Shirou’s refusal.
findings.explanation: The English removes the conspicuous maximum degree of Rin’s pleasure, weakening the comic and emotional force of her reaction.

findings.evidenceJa: 体中がんじがらめにしてたところよ
findings.governingReading: Rin says she would have bound Shirou’s entire body fast if he had answered yes.
findings.explanation: The English removes the whole-body scope and tightly immobilizing force of Rin’s hypothetical precaution.

findings.highlight: I wanted to know what you thought
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎の気持ちを知りたかった
findings.governingReading: Rin wanted to know Shirou’s feelings.
findings.explanation: The English recasts Rin’s emotionally concerned inquiry as a request for his opinion or thought.

findings.highlight: don’t ever say you’ll take the Shroud off
findings.evidenceJa: 聖骸布を外そうなんて決して思わないで
findings.governingReading: Rin tells Shirou never even to think of removing the Shroud.
findings.explanation: The English relocates Rin’s absolute prohibition from Shirou’s intention to his speech, materially weakening the safety rule governing Archer’s arm.
